exposure: microorganism infection (Yeast, mould, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella species, Streptococcus species, Staphylococcus species, Candida albican)
outcome: types of microorganisms in fetal membrane, placental membrane, and amniotic fluid
cohort: The participants included 20 women with preterm birth (with or without premature rupture of membranes) and a control group of 10 women with term delivery.
finding: In women with preterm birth, the most dominant microorganisms associated with chorioamnionitis were yeast (28.4%) and mould (28.4%), and similar microorganisms were also found in term birth controls (Yeast 50-67%, mould 30-33%).
